# FFmpeg 7.1.1 public headers

Compile-time headers only, for loading the system FFmpeg at runtime with library
majors libavcodec 61, libavformat 61, libavutil 59, libswscale 8 and
libswresample 5 (SteamOS 3.8). No FFmpeg code is compiled or linked from here and
no FFmpeg library is shipped with CRT XR.

- Source: https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-7.1.1.tar.xz
  (SHA-256 `733984395e0dbbe5c046abda2dc49a5544e7e0e1e2366bba849222ae9e3a03b1`)
- Selection: each library's installed `HEADERS`/`ARCH_HEADERS` from its Makefile.
- `libavutil/avconfig.h` is generated by FFmpeg's configure and was written by hand
  for x86_64.
- Licence: GNU LGPL 2.1 or later, see `COPYING.LGPLv2.1`.
